+"""Check that table privileges can be granted in a freshly created database."""
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import uuid
+
+
+CHECK_ID = "table_select_grant_on_new_database_is_usable"
+ORIGIN = "generated_from_fresh_database_permission_report"
+
+
+def run(argv, sql=None, timeout=120):
+    return subprocess.run(argv, input=sql, text=True, capture_output=True,
+                          timeout=timeout, check=False)
+
+
+def process_result(proc):
+    return {"returncode": proc.returncode, "stdout": proc.stdout, "stderr": proc.stderr}
+
+
+def emit(phase, *, passed=False, actual=None, error=None, reproduced=False):
+    check = {"name": CHECK_ID, "kind": "target", "passed": passed}
+    if actual is not None:
+        check["actual"] = {"phase": phase, **actual}
+    result = {"checks": [check], "reproduced": reproduced, "origin": ORIGIN}
+    if error:
+        result.update({"harness_error": error, "phase": phase})
+    print("CHECK_RESULT=" + json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
+
+
+def sql_literal(value):
+    return "'" + value.replace("'", "''") + "'"
+
+
+def main():
+    source_dsn = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN")
+    if not source_dsn:
+        emit("environment", error="ACREPAIR_FIREBIRD_DSN_REQUIRED", actual={})
+        return
+
+    isql = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ISQL", "isql")
+    admin = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_ADMIN_USER", "SYSDBA")
+    password = os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_PASSWORD_" + admin.upper(), "masterkey")
+    admin_source = [isql, "-user", admin, "-password", password, source_dsn]
+    timeout = int(os.environ.get("ACREPAIR_QUERY_TIMEOUT", "120"))
+    suffix = uuid.uuid4().hex[:10].upper()
+    user = "AC_NEWDB_USER_" + suffix
+    user_password = "newdb_" + suffix.lower()
+    table = "AC_NEWDB_TABLE_" + suffix
+    row_marker = 7321
+    setup = None
+    created_db = None
+
+    try:
+        setup = run(admin_source,
+                    "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+                    f"CREATE USER {user} PASSWORD '{user_password}';\n"
+                    "COMMIT;\n",
+                    timeout)
+        if setup.returncode != 0:
+            emit("user_setup", error="TEMPORARY_USER_SETUP_FAILED",
+                 actual=process_result(setup))
+            return
+
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="acrepair-firebird-newdb-") as temp_dir:
+            os.chmod(temp_dir, 0o755)
+            database_path = Path(temp_dir) / "new_database.fdb"
+            created_db = str(database_path)
+            database_dsn = "localhost:" + created_db
+            create_database = run(
+                [isql],
+                "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+                f"CREATE DATABASE {sql_literal(database_dsn)} USER {sql_literal(admin)} "
+                f"PASSWORD {sql_literal(password)};\n"
+                f"CREATE TABLE {table} (ID INTEGER);\n"
+                f"INSERT INTO {table} VALUES ({row_marker});\n"
+                "COMMIT;\n",
+                timeout,
+            )
+            if create_database.returncode != 0:
+                emit("create_database", error="FRESH_DATABASE_CREATION_FAILED",
+                     actual=process_result(create_database))
+                return
+
+            fresh_admin = [isql, "-user", admin, "-password", password, database_dsn]
+            grant = run(fresh_admin,
+                        "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+                        f"GRANT SELECT ON {table} TO {user};\n"
+                        "COMMIT;\n",
+                        timeout)
+            if grant.returncode != 0:
+                emit("grant", error="GRANT_FAILED_WITHOUT_STABLE_REPORT_SIGNATURE",
+                     actual=process_result(grant))
+                return
+
+            grantee = run(
+                [isql, "-user", user, "-password", user_password, database_dsn],
+                "SET BAIL ON;\n"
+                f"SELECT 'ACREPAIR_ROW=' || CAST(ID AS VARCHAR(20)) FROM {table};\n",
+                timeout,
+            )
+            if grantee.returncode != 0 or f"ACREPAIR_ROW={row_marker}" not in grantee.stdout:
+                emit("grantee_select", error="GRANTEE_SELECT_FAILED_WITHOUT_STABLE_REPORT_SIGNATURE",
+                     actual=process_result(grantee))
+                return
+
+            emit("complete", passed=True, actual={
+                "grant": process_result(grant),
+                "grantee_select": process_result(grantee),
+            })
+    except (OSError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:
+        emit("runner", error="COMMAND_OR_TIMEOUT_ERROR", actual={
+            "error": type(exc).__name__, "detail": str(exc),
+        })
+    finally:
+        if setup is not None and setup.returncode == 0:
+            cleanup = run(admin_source,
+                          "SET BAIL OFF;\n"
+                          f"DROP USER {user};\n"
+                          "COMMIT;\n",
+                          timeout=60)
+            if cleanup.returncode != 0:
+                print("CLEANUP_WARNING=" + cleanup.stdout + cleanup.stderr,
+                      file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+        if created_db and Path(created_db).exists():
+            try:
+                Path(created_db).unlink()
+            except OSError as exc:
+                print("CLEANUP_WARNING=database_file:" + str(exc),
+                      file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+def main():
